title: Scam centers – level 2
paragraphs: People often get calls or messages from someone who says they are a bank or a friend. These scams take money from people all over the world.

Some criminal groups make large buildings to trick people. Some workers go there to make money, but others must do it. If they don’t want to, they get hurt. Scammers use fake pictures and messages to make people give them money. Some workers get away or get help from their countries. Governments try to close these buildings, but the criminals have power. They work in many countries. People need to be careful with calls, messages, or online friends. It is the only way they can stop scammers from taking their money.

words.d: a plan to take someone’s money by lying or cheating
a person who tries to take money from others by lying
